create_optimizer: create an optimizer from configuration supporting kfac and optax optimizers with learning rate schedules
build_tf1_rmsprop: build an RMSProp optimizer equivalent to tf.compat.v1.train.RMSPropOptimizer using optax transformations
build_kfac_bn_registration_kwargs: build kfac kwargs for batch-norm registration strategy with generic, full, or diag modes
test_create_optimizer_kfac: test the create_optimizer function with kfac optimizer name and config for training
review_tf1_rmsprop: review the tf1_rmsprop function that chains optax transformations for RMSProp with momentum
